title: Starwrath rank 100
problem: Sets every enemy's Confused chance to 10%, lowering it for enemies that *are* Confused (50%→10%).
notes: Fix: H: only raise, never lower Hook batch R (loader/hooks_R.c, research/hooks_R.json). In-game test: Starwrath rank 100: a Confused enemy still redirects about half its attacks/harmful spells (not 10%); an enemy without Confused redirects about 10%.

release_notes.intended: Enemies that are not Confused have a 10% chance to act as if they were Confused.
release_notes.actual: The game applied the 10% to enemies that were already Confused, lowering their real Confused chance to 10%, and did nothing for the others.
release_notes.fix: Now the 10% chance applies to enemies without Confused, and real Confused enemies keep their normal chance.
